bundle.shortDescription: Local terminals and managed Codex sessions
bundle.longDescription: Wyss Console is a desktop client for local terminals and for managed Codex sessions. It starts its own authority (wyss-control) under your login session's service manager, which keeps your sessions, approvals and history. Linux with a systemd user session is supported.
